behavior: Entering a ZIP or postal code fills in the state or province.
Next is not available when an answer makes the applicant ineligible; the reason is shown.
If Spouse is selected, spouse details are required. If Child is selected, at least one child must be added.
On Next, the applicant is checked against the TPA's member records. When the match needs identity verification, a verification dialog opens before the page continues.
When a saved application has just been resumed, a notice confirms it was loaded.
